items.exampleEn: Thank you for the flowers, sweetheart.
The story is about a little orphan who finds a new family.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事是在講一個小孤兒找到新家庭的經過。

items.exampleEn: The class is for children aged six to ten.
items.exampleZh: 這堂課是給六到十歲的孩子上的。

items.exampleEn: My granddad is ninety years old.
Ms. Lin is our new English teacher.
items.exampleZh: 林女士是我們新來的英文老師。

items.exampleEn: I have a penfriend in Japan.

items.sentenceEn: My granddaughter is visiting us this weekend.
items.sentenceZh: 我孫女這個週末要來看我們。

items.audioEn: I write to my penfriend every month, and she always writes back.
items.audioZh: 我每個月都寫信給我的筆友，她也總是會回信。
items.questionZh: 說話的人多久和筆友寫一次信？

items.sentenceEn: Granny and Granddad live in the countryside.
Ms. Wang, this is my mother.

items.stemEn: This course is for people ____ sixty and over.
items.stemZh: 這門課程是給六十歲以上的人上的。

items.stemEn: Children with no parents are called ____.
items.stemZh: 沒有父母的孩子叫做孤兒。

items.passageEn: Granny Chen is eighty years old. She was an orphan, so she grew up without a family. When she was ten, her teacher, Ms. Lin, found her a penfriend in England. The two girls wrote letters to each other for seventy years! Today, Granny has a big family. She often reads the old letters to her granddaughter and calls her "sweetheart."
items.passageZh: 陳奶奶今年八十歲。她是個孤兒，從小沒有家人。她十歲的時候，她的老師林女士幫她在英國找了一個筆友。兩個女孩互相寫信寫了七十年！現在奶奶有一個大家庭。她常常把那些舊信唸給孫女聽，還叫孫女「親愛的」。

questions.questionZh: 陳奶奶小時候，老師幫她做了什麼？
options: 每週教她做好吃的英國家常菜
送她去英國的一所大學讀書
幫她在英國找了一個筆友

questions.questionZh: 她和筆友互相寫信寫了多久？

items.promptZh: 我爺爺每天早上去公園散步。
referenceEn: My granddad walks in the park every morning.
My granddad goes for a walk in the park every morning.
rubricZh: 每天的習慣用現在式，主詞是第三人稱單數，動詞要加 s（例如 walks、goes）

items.promptZh: 我的筆友下個月會來看我。
referenceEn: My penfriend will come to see me next month.
My penfriend is going to visit me next month.
rubricZh: 下個月的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to 等）
「來看我」可寫，例如 come to see me、visit me 等
